identity_reason: a heading takes its size from the type scale and its level from the outline, so it has no form to derive
concept: A heading whose level comes from the page outline and whose size comes from the scale, so structure and look never fight.

root.why: the heading family, weight and tight leading shared by every level of the outline

display.why: the display size for the one title that opens a page or a hero

headline.why: the headline size for sections of a page in the outline

title.why: the title size for the heading of a card or a pane

emphasis.why: the emphasis size for small headings inside a card or a list
